notes.title: Version 1.0 released
“Pen and paper” puzzles (1 to 5)

Puzlogic version 1.0 will be released in 2 days.

Meanwhile, I’ve thought giving you some puzzles I’ve made, to solved by hand (newspaper style).
You’re welcome to present the solutions here, but please use the spoiler tag.
